[HOME G28] - Returns all axes to machine zero. To send just one axis to machine home,
enter the axis letter and press [HOME G28]. To zero out all axes on the Distance-To-Go
display, while in Jog mode, press any other operation mode ([EDIT], [MEMORY],
[MDI/DNC], etc.) then press [HANDLE JOG]. Each axis can be zeroed independently to
show a position relative to the selected zero. To do this go to the Position Operator
page, press [HANDLE JOG], position the axes to the desired position and press [ORIGIN]
to zero that display. In addition a number can be entered for the axis position display. To
do this, enter an axis and number, for example, X2.125 then [ORIGIN].
